[Marginal Revolution] UK fact of the day — UK panel data, 1991-2019. Couples who support different parties separate more often. The effect is as strong as some other mismatches, like education. Disagreement over Brexit mattered even more than party preference. Here is a longer Nikolaus Haufler thread on European fertility, with a variety of interesting observations about other countries.
